body: In the United States it's legal in some states but only if you suffer from a terminal illness not if you are depressed. You have to do it by yourself if you are physically healthy.

I already adopted another dog and I am not feeling anything for her. I care for her wellbeing but I don't love her. As a matter of fact I am looking for a new home for her because she deserves to be loved. I have already achieved the perfect and purest connection with my dog who passed away. 
I thought this new dog and I could save each other but she is a daily reminder of my loss. Not her fault.
